product_overview: Enterprise Admin Portal is a comprehensive web application designed for managing organizational workflows including user authentication, user and attendance management, report and payment processing, and administrative dashboard analytics. It supports role-based access for admins, managers, and users to ensure efficient and secure operations.
core_goals: Provide secure, role-based user authentication and session management.
Enable efficient user management including user creation, invitation, and deletion with role-based permissions.
Support seamless report and payment upload, review, and approval workflows.
Facilitate accurate attendance tracking with geolocation and photo verification.
Deliver role-based dashboards with analytics and recent activities to enhance administrative oversight.
Provide real-time notifications for system events and approvals.
Offer configurable system settings such as session timeout and geofencing to adapt to organizational policies.
key_features: User Authentication with login, logout, password reset, and session timeout management supporting admin, manager, and user roles.
User Management system to create, invite, delete users with appropriate role assignments and permissions.
Report Upload and Management allows users to upload Excel reports and enables admins and managers to view, approve, or reject them.
Payment Management feature for users to upload payment proofs with review and approval/rejection by admins and managers.
Attendance Management capturing user attendance submissions with geolocation and photo evidence reviewed by higher roles.
Dashboard Analytics presenting role-specific statistics and recent activities on dedicated dashboards for admin, manager, and user roles.
Real-time Notifications for approvals, rejections, and key system events to keep users informed.
Settings Management to configure system-wide options like session timeout duration, geofencing parameters, and integrations.
user_flow_summary: User logs in through the authentication system; session is managed actively with timeout controls.
Admins and managers create or invite new users and assign roles through the user management interface.
Users upload Excel reports and payment proofs which admins and managers review, approve, or reject accordingly.
Users submit attendance with geolocation and photo; managers and admins review submissions for validation.
Users and managers access dashboards tailored to role with analytics and recent activity updates.
Notifications are pushed in real-time to users based on relevant events such as approvals or system messages.
System administrators adjust settings such as session timeout, geofencing policies, and integration configurations via settings page.
validation_criteria: Successful role-based user authentication and authorization with session management.
Ability to create, invite, and delete users with correct role assignments and permission enforcement.
Reports and payments can be uploaded, listed, reviewed, approved, or rejected with accurate status tracking.
Attendance submissions include valid geolocation and photo evidence and are properly reviewed.
Dashboards update dynamically with correct statistics and recent activities per user role.
Notifications are delivered in real-time for relevant system and user events.
Settings changes persist correctly and impact system behavior as configured.
